title: AI-APPROVE: John approval or refusal of AI data sharing
public_pr_body:
AI-APPROVE: John approval or refusal of AI data sharing. Adds `docs/signoff/AI-APPROVE-JOHN-DATA-SHARING.md` and a job handover. Plain words, blank choices/checks, expected results where relevant and signature/evidence lines for the actual named people.

Validation: source/control/example review and `git diff --check`. Documentation only; no artificial text tests added. Actual decisions/signatures, portal terms/free-tier eligibility and operator/manual/provider/database actions remain NOT RUN. PAID-ROUND is paid working time, confirmed by Rhys. Domain checks come before app callbacks.

Prepared for build/test by Friday 6 November and conditional go-live Thursday 12 November 2026. Draft only, no Ready label, main merge, production SQL, deployment, live account change, app registration, purchase or send.
